commit_message: Rebase ADR 0112 secondary motion onto current main
pr_body:
## Summary

Rebuilds the ADR 0112 implementation from #28 on the current `main` baseline without changing the architecture or serialized contracts beyond the explicit ADR 0112 identity cutover.

- replaces the MMD-specific runtime bridge with engine-native Secondary Motion APIs and isolated fixed-step simulation
- preserves gameplay-physics isolation and writes simulation only through the RigPose physics layer
- converts PMX rigid bodies/joints best-effort with actionable diagnostics
- introduces the explicit `engine.secondary_motion` / `SecondaryMotionRig` authoring identity and deterministic imported-ID namespace
- keeps scene conversion atomic by restoring replaced Secondary Motion registry entries on rollback
- updates Editor labels/preview isolation and the canonical authoring/MMD/ADR documentation
- preserves the newer current-main AI Studio specification while adding the ADR 0112 schema section

## Validation required

Run the repository-selected Windows Validation scope and inspect its machine-readable summary. Because Editor-visible labels and preview behavior change, run Editor Visual Validation and inspect the captured image.

This Draft PR supersedes #28 after the current-main validation succeeds.
